digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter transport / client construction
propositions: A missing JIRA_PAT resolves to an empty string and is passed as token_auth, causing the client to build and issue anonymous requests instead of failing.
The documented security guarantee that a missing JIRA_PAT fails with an error naming the variable is not enforced; the backend fails open to anonymous access.
An anonymous request yields Jira's 'project does not exist' error, misattributing a missing credential to a nonexistent project.
The PAT must be validated at client construction (build_client_from_settings) and reject empty or whitespace-only values with an error naming JIRA_PAT and its anonymous-fallback consequence.
Settings resolution must stay total and not raise on a missing credential, so Protocol conformance checks via hasattr on query_project keep passing on Python 3.11.
A PAT present only in a config file must not satisfy the check, preserving the environment-only contract.
